name: Quest 01
title: Who's the Riddle Master?
description: A student wearing an afro wants to test your intellect with a series of riddles. You must answer them correctly to prove your street smarts.

name: Quest 02
title: Acquire an Angel Statue
description: A student needs an Angel Statue for a project. It is said to drop from the Avenger Knight shadows haunting the early floors of Yukiko's Castle.

name: Quest 03
title: Feed the Cat
description: A hungry cat hanging around the riverbank wants some fish. Bring it a Chub or a Tatsuhime Ladybug from your bait supply.
requirements: Need a Fishing Rod and bait.
